desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community focused on a major ongoing PLA exercise simulating prolonged Taiwan isolation, scattered Iranian UAV/air-defence activity across multiple provinces, Russian Black Sea blockade self-harm on maritime trade, and granular Ukrainian infantry control in contested urban areas. The single most important thread is ISW’s assessment that the PLA is practising sustained operations to keep US/allied forces from reaching Taiwan.

## MAIN THREADS
### PLA Taiwan-isolation exercise
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2121320653403914678) and follow-up report that the PRC is very likely continuing the unannounced major exercise first assessed 6 Nov, with naval operations sustained beyond the first island chain between Taiwan and Guam.
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2121320677097525336) links the full 13 Nov China-Taiwan update.

### Iranian UAV and air-defence activity
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121321603522781510) reports UAVs over Urmia (West Azerbaijan) and air-defence activity over Ordushahi at ~22:08–22:10 local.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121321137476944295) notes a missile launcher observed on the Baharestan–Mohammadabad road, Isfahan Province.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121320920094560551) records UAV activity over the Fifth Base, Omidiyeh (Khuzestan) at 1727Z.

### Russian Black Sea blockade effects
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2121325731053506632) cites Ukrainian Navy spokesperson Pletenchuk: Moscow is rerouting grain/metal exports to Baltic ports at higher cost and time, while Baltic attacks show the shift does not remove security risks.

### Ukrainian urban control
- [@RALee85](https://x.com/RALee85/status/2121319905903730937) quotes @moklasen to explain that “control” in a southeastern/eastern city sector remains fluid; infantry from both sides occupy different parts of the same buildings and avoid mutual engagement to limit UAS targeting.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121321062101086320): jet takeoff from Doran AB heading south at 21:00 local (unconfirmed).  
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2121320986205167888): Hormozgan Governor’s office states “no impacts or explosions in Jask as of 22:25 local” (unconfirmed).  
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2121325731053506632): Russian exports now increasingly routed via Baltic ports (unconfirmed).  
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2121320653403914678): PLA practising ability to prevent US/allied reinforcement of Taiwan for an extended period (unconfirmed beyond ISW assessment).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch whether the PLA exercise extends further or draws US/allied response; any follow-on Iranian strikes or Israeli retaliation; and whether Russian Baltic rerouting triggers additional attacks. Urban fighting granularity in Ukraine remains a focus for mapping updates.
